summary: All nine occurrences reviewed. Keep glossary stem I and single sense1 sich einigen; inherited Arabic VIII etymology does not create a Turoyo Detransitive.

Agreement content may be a d-clause (JTM1.6/2); basis is ʕal (32/28,90/144); reciprocal partners occur as ʕam ḥḏoḏe (84/8) or inside a plural subject. These are compatible frames of one meaning, not separate collocations.

Preterit marks achieved agreement, a result-checking question (-xun), or a compact confirmed now (115/285). The latter has two tokens, each with its own decision. 39/31 repeats the agreement already announced in39/28; no chronological rewrite is made.

New Imperativ mtafequ and Infectum gmitafqina are added with their exact reduced spellings. They fit this entry's agreement formation; related wfq and tfq are checked without moving inherited wtfq material.
No independently lexicalized idiom or new sense is established; wedding and political settlement are agreement contents.

Məttafqituwo combines a 2pl Infectum ending and -wo in a question about customary arrangements; it differs from the round-1 Preterit 2pl agent ending -xun. Keep stem I and active status: the inherited Arabic VIII formation is not a Turoyo Detransitive or a new stem.

The reader’s claim that only Preterit exists applies to the unrevised entry. Round 1 already adds Imperativ and Infectum; Jan adds only the still missing Infectum-wa. Preterit already has five examples.

The quoted future clause bə flan dukṯo gəd ḥuzena ḥḏoḏe specifies an agreement’s content. It is not a light-verb plus noun construction, and the reciprocal expression belongs to the embedded seeing event; no independent idiom is proposed.
Confirm mtafequ at84/8 as Imperativ of this borrowed paradigm, and its reduced single-t spelling.
How are gmitafqina and mtafaqqe related to the head forms məttafaqle/məttafəq, and to wfq? Keep source spellings pending that dialectal comparison.

Does -ituwo here mark customary past agreement throughout this dialect, and how does its reduced məttafq- base relate to round-1 gmitafqina and mtafequ? Preserve the attested spelling until the paradigm is documented.
Quoted future meeting arrangements can supply the content of agreeing. This complements the round-1 d-clause content, ʕal-basis and reciprocal partner frames without a new sense.
